brief: Customer support before vs after AI — ticket time dropped from hours to minutes.

slots.title: Stop wasting
slots.description: AI shrinks your support queue from hours to minutes without extra headcount.

slots.title: Tickets pile
slots.description: Manual sorting buries urgent requests under a mountain of open threads.
slots.badText: Agents spent 45 minutes triaging every incoming batch by hand.
slots.goodText: AI instantly tags, prioritizes, and routes tickets to the right queue.

slots.title: Replies take
slots.description: Customers wait hours for a first response while agents context-switch.
slots.badText: Average first reply stretched past four hours during peak volume.
slots.goodText: AI drafts and sends personalized first responses in seconds.

slots.title: Digging for
slots.description: Agents waste time hunting order history and past notes across tabs.
slots.badText: Agents toggled between six tools just to understand one issue.
slots.goodText: AI surfaces customer history and suggests fixes automatically.

slots.title: Close tickets
slots.description: Full resolution drops from hours to minutes when AI handles the heavy lifting.
slots.badText: Complex tickets looped through three shifts before final resolution.
slots.goodText: AI resolves tier-one issues end-to-end without human escalation.

slots.title: Agents are
slots.description: Repetitive tickets burn out your team and kill productivity daily.
slots.badText: Agents repeated the same password reset answers fifty times daily.
slots.goodText: AI deflects repetitive work so agents focus on high-value conversations.

slots.title: Customers hate
slots.description: Faster resolutions turn frustrated users into loyal advocates overnight.
slots.badText: Slow support drove negative reviews and churn every single month.
slots.goodText: Instant answers and warm handoffs boosted satisfaction scores dramatically.

slots.body: Join teams replacing hour-long queues with instant AI resolutions. Setup takes one day.
